item.title: Does AI Assistance Enhance or Erode Expertise? — Mara’s oral adaptation
item.description:
Mara presents a source-grounded oral adaptation of the September 2026 NBER working paper on a three-month randomized experiment with patent lawyers. Covers the drafting and unaided redlining tasks, findings by experience, possible mechanisms, and limits of the evidence. 23:07; nine chapters. Synthetic narration generated locally with Kokoro Heart. This is an adaptation, not a verbatim reading. The source is a working paper, not peer reviewed.

Sources (APA)

  • Autor, D., Rodchenko, T., Martin, J., Iscenko, Z., Strand, S., Pearl, D., & Ferere, M. (2026). Does AI assistance enhance or erode expertise? Evidence from a three-month field experiment in patent drafting (NBER Working Paper No. 35720). National Bureau of Economic Research. https://doi.org/10.3386/w35720
